albums.title: Mimi Ni Odogwu
albums.description: The title joins Swahili and Igbo: “Mimi ni” means “I am”, and “Odogwu” is a word for a strong, respected man. It is a confident statement of identity, set against glowing city lights and a smooth, romantic Afro Soul Pop sound.

tracks.title: Utajiri wako unaanza sasa
tracks.subtitle: (Remastered)
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Nimeamka na maono mapya leo,
Utajiri sio namba tu kwenye akaunti,
Ni amani ya moyo, na maono ya kesho.

[Chorus]
Utajiri wako unaanza sasa,
Fungua macho, fikra ziko huru,
Mimi ni Odogwu, mshindi wa maisha!

[Outro]
Anza sasa, usisubiri kesho.

tracks.title: Ukombozi wa Kifikra
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Ukombozi wa kifikra ndio msingi wa kila kitu,
Ukijitambua wewe ni nani, hakuna anayeweza kukuzuia.

[Chorus]
Inawezekana, inawezekana, Odogwu!
Ukombozi wa kifikra, maisha mapya yanazaliwa.

tracks.title: Wife’s Best Friend
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
She knows all your secrets, she knows all your smiles,
Walking together through the longest miles.

[Chorus]
Wife's best friend, holding it together,
Love and connection that will last forever.

tracks.title: Inawezekana
tracks.subtitle: ft. Zimbermanne
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Hakuna kinachoshindikana pale unapoweka nia.
Simama imara, jiamini, siku mpya imeanza.

[Chorus]
Inawezekana! Ndoto zako zitakamilika.

tracks.title: Mimi ni Odogwu
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
LEADER: Mimi ni Odogwu, najiona tayari!
CROWD: Najiona tayari!

[Verse 1]
Jana nilisema 'mimi sina kitu',
Nilihesabu sarafu, moyo mzito.
Leo nauliza: 'Pesa iko wapi?'
Macho yamefunguka, fursa kila kona!

[Chorus]
LEADER: Mimi ni Odogwu, najiona tayari!
CROWD: Najiona tayari!
LEADER: Mikono na akili, vyote vinafanya kazi!
ALL: Odogwu! Odogwu!

tracks.title: Mke wa Pili
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Mapenzi ya dhati hayawezi kupimwa kwa maneno tu,
Heshima na uaminifu ndio msingi wa nyumba.

tracks.title: No Be Matter
tracks.subtitle: Chidimma ft. Zimbermanne
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
No be matter of talk, na action we dey show,
When Afro rhythm hits, everybody go know.

[Chorus]
No be matter, love go lead us home.

tracks.title: Taarifa Yako
tracks.subtitle: Maino ft. Zimbermanne
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
Taarifa yako! Tucheze wote!

[Verse 1]
Mawazo yako ndio ramani yako ya kesho,
Eneza upendo na furaha mahali kote.

tracks.title: Taarifa Yako
tracks.subtitle: (Techno Version)
tracks.lyrics:
[High-energy beat drop]
Taarifa yako! Techno rhythm taking over the dancefloor.

tracks.title: Ione ile boti baharini
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Tazama bahari, boti inasafiri kwa amani,
Safari ya maisha ina mawimbi, lakini tutafika nchi kavu.

tracks.title: Mimi na Tajiri sana
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Utajiri sio hela pekee, utajiri ni afya na upendo,
Mimi ni tajiri sana kwa sababu nina watu wanaonipenda.

tracks.title: Pesa inaongea sana
tracks.subtitle: Malume ft. Zimbermanne
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Jana nilisema, 'mimi sina kitu',
Leo nauliza, 'Pesa iko wapi?'
Pesa ikifanya kazi, kesho inakupa nafasi,
Jifunze, wekeza, anza hata kwa kiasi.

[Bridge]
Nitaenda kijijini, nikakae na wazee,
Chini ya mti, swali moja moyoni:
'Mzee, nifanyeje? Kibati changu hakijai!'

[Chorus]
Pesa inaongea sana, Pesa ikiwa na mpango,
Kesho inakuwa sawa! Kibati cha kijiji kinahitaji kibati imara.

tracks.title: odogwu_shift
tracks.subtitle: (Remix, Affirmation Version)
tracks.lyrics:
[Affirmation chant]
I am strong, I am focused, I am Odogwu.
Shift your energy, embrace your greatness.

tracks.title: 200 Billion
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Dreaming big, aiming for two hundred billion,
Hard work, strategy, and relentless faith.

albums.title: A Mafia’s Diary
albums.description: A darker, more cinematic chapter. Framed by snowfall and the domes and towers of Moscow, this record reads like pages from a private diary: power, loyalty and tenderness, all carried by the same soulful Afro rhythm.

tracks.title: Peak-Time Pulse
tracks.lyrics:
[Instrumental & Atmospheric Vibe]
Snow falling quiet over the city lights,
Heartbeats pulsing in the dark of night.

tracks.title: Highway Velocity Chase
tracks.lyrics:
[Fast tempo beat]
Speeding through the midnight boulevard,
Keeping secrets close and playing every card.

tracks.title: Internet Babe
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Glowing screens in a cold room,
Internet babe, clearing out the gloom.

albums.title: The Weight of Gold: The Chronicles
albums.description: A heavy, atmospheric blend of trip-hop, industrial groove and storytelling. A reflective journey exploring wealth, ambition, and the true cost of chasing power.

tracks.title: Drown in Me
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Deep bass rolling in the background,
Lost in the rhythms that we found.

[Chorus]
Drown in me, let the gold wash over you.

tracks.title: The Blonde Front Desk
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Late check-in at midnight, marble floors,
Standing right at the hotel doors.

tracks.title: Bless This Man Tonight
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
A prayer spoken in the quiet hour,
Seeking wisdom, peace and power.

[Chorus]
Bless this man tonight as he walks his path.

tracks.title: Let It Come
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Whatever the future holds, I'm ready now,
Standing tall, making my vow.

[Chorus]
Let it come, let the rain fall down.

tracks.title: Muddy Waters
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Navigating through the muddy stream,
Never letting go of the golden dream.

tracks.title: Thank You for Loving Me
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Through the high roads and the valleys low,
Your love is the constant light I know.

[Chorus]
Thank you for loving me, holding me tight.
